Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D sprite animation sheet for a corrupted bear in Hellwall.
REFERENCE: the attached approved bear sprite defines the ONE character. Preserve its jagged wounded ursine face, raw open maw, wasted heavy forequarters, exposed ivory rib cage, ragged brown fur/hide, sick olive-green and black stringy sludge, restrained dark red bloody tears and skin strips. It is unnaturally barely alive, never smooth/plastic/cute. Same body proportions and palette in EVERY frame. Do not invent armor, horns, extra limbs, neon glow, giant boils, or props.
CAMERA: elevated orthographic isometric view, looking down at 30 degrees above horizontal. All frames use exactly the same camera, lighting, facing and character scale.
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: exactly SIX COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, exactly THIRTY separate full-body poses. Equal-sized rectangular cells on a strict grid, regular spacing, no drawn grid lines. Suggested canvas 1536 x 1280, each cell 256 x 256. Center each bear in its cell with consistent ground baseline near 88% cell height. Generous clear transparent gutters; no cropping or touching adjacent cells. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no ground, no cast shadow, text, numbers, labels, border or watermark.
ROW 1 IDLE: six consecutive frames of subtle labored breathing, ribs expand then contract, head dips and rises, hanging sludge stretches. Feet planted. Seamless six-frame loop.
ROW 2 WALK: six consecutive, clearly DIFFERENT frames of a slow limping quadrupedal walk IN PLACE. Front-left and rear-right advance then plant, opposite pair pass and advance, body weight lurches and head bobs; distinct foot placements in every frame. Exactly four anatomically connected legs. Sludge follows with lag. Seamless six-frame loop. Body stays centered.
ROW 3 ATTACK: six chronological frames of a heavy bite-and-forepaw strike: 1 crouch ready; 2 recoil/raise head and one forepaw; 3 lunge forward/down with jaws open; 4 maximal bite/paw impact; 5 pull back; 6 ready pose. Same scale and ground position; visible anatomically plausible pose changes.
ROW 4 HIT REACTION: six chronological frames: 1 standing ready; 2 head jerks back; 3 shoulder/torso flinch; 4 buckle slightly; 5 recover; 6 standing ready. This animal's death is NOT on this row.
ROW 5 DEATH: six chronological frames: 1 legs buckle; 2 shoulders fall; 3 torso rolls onto its side; 4 body collapsed flat on ground; 5 soft tissues/sludge sag outward; 6 motionless collapsed bear with ribs/skull still recognizable. Last three frames must be prone, NOT standing again. No disappearance, no exploded gore, no detached limbs.
Style: crisp painted 2D game art, broken organic contours, readable ivory face/ribs against medium-dark umber/olive body. Broad strong lighting groups, restrained texture suitable for reduction to ~60 pixels. Consistent upper-left lighting. Never a 3D render.
DIRECTION FOR EVERY CELL: Facing SOUTHWEST, toward bottom-left of the sheet: head at lower-left, rump at upper-right, see front of face and LEFT flank. This is the reference direction, maintain its appearance.
